parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: This is the leg of the pliers, made of high-strength steel. It is one of the two handles that provide leverage for gripping and cutting.
parts.Functional_description: The leg functions as a lever arm that transmits force from the user's hand to the jaws, enabling gripping or cutting actions.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the base body, allowing the jaws to open and close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the pliers, made of durable steel. It includes the pivot joint and one of the gripping jaws.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support and houses the pivot mechanism that connects to the leg, ensuring smooth operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary while the leg rotates around the pivot, enabling the gripping motion of the pliers.
